title: Exercise EMBER LINE 2026 (MOCK)
organisation: Marlow Valley Regional Emergency Management Group
hazard: Fast-moving grass and scrub fire on the urban edge
location: Harrow Ridge and the township of Dunmore
aim: To practise an out-of-hours activation of the Marlow Valley EOC and the coordination of partner agencies during a wind-driven fire threatening the township of Dunmore.
objectives: O1 - Activate the EOC out of hours and establish a common operating picture within 30 minutes.
O2 - Apply pre-agreed triggers to make an evacuation decision within 15 minutes.
O3 - Coordinate multi-agency resources, including requests for mutual aid.
O4 - Deliver consistent public information and correct rumour through a single spokesperson.
O5 - Identify and protect vulnerable people and facilities.
O6 - Maintain operations through a loss of primary communications.

agencies.role: Lead agency. Controller, Operations, Planning, Logistics, Public Information (PIO).
Fire attack, structure protection, fire behaviour advice.
Casualty care, movement of non-ambulant patients.
Delivers injects, simulates all non-playing agencies, media and public.

scenario_background: After six weeks without rain the fire danger rating for the Marlow Valley is Extreme. A dry north-westerly of 45 km/h, gusting to 70 km/h, is forecast until midnight.
Dunmore (population 5,200) sits below Harrow Ridge. The Ridgeview estate (about 280 homes), Dunmore Primary School and Harrow Lodge rest home back directly onto scrub.
It is a weekday evening. Most EOC staff have gone home. The exercise starts at 17:00 with a report of smoke on Harrow Ridge.

phases.name: Phase 1 - Warning and activation
phases.summary: First reports, out-of-hours call-in, EOC activation.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Escalation and evacuation
phases.summary: Fire crosses the ridge, evacuation decision for Ridgeview.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Peak impact
phases.summary: Vulnerable facilities, rumour, loss of communications.

injects.message: Multiple calls reporting smoke and flame on the north face of Harrow Ridge. Two appliances are responding. The fire is about 2 hectares and spreading uphill.
The fire is now 15 hectares and has reached the ridge line. With this wind it could reach the back fences of Ridgeview in 60 to 90 minutes.
expected_actions: Map properties at risk in Ridgeview
Brief the Controller against the evacuation triggers

injects.message: Spot fires have started 300 m ahead of the main front, on the Dunmore side of the ridge. I recommend evacuating Ridgeview now.
expected_actions: Task Police with door-knocking and traffic control

injects.message: We have 36 residents, 9 of them bed-bound, and only two night staff on site. We have one minibus. We are not on any list we know of. What should we do?
Ridge Road, the main route out of Ridgeview, is blocked by a two-vehicle crash in heavy smoke. One person is trapped. Traffic is backing up into the estate.
Posts online say Dunmore Primary School has burned down with children still inside at an after-school programme. Can you confirm? We go to air in ten minutes.
expected_actions: Confirm the facts with Fire and Police
Issue a correction through the single spokesperson
Tell the Controller and all functions

injects.message: The fire has damaged the Harrow Ridge radio repeater. Primary radio is down across the district and mobile coverage in Dunmore is congested.
expected_actions: Confirm contact with every field team

injects.message: The wind has dropped and swung to the south. The fire is contained at the Ridgeview boundary. Eleven homes are damaged. Begin the transition to recovery. ENDEX will be called at 21:00.
expected_actions: List the first five recovery priorities

rules_of_play: All exercise messages begin and end with the words EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE.
The code words NO DUFF mean a real emergency or injury. Play stops immediately.
Players respond as they would in a real event, using current plans and procedures.
Do not contact anyone outside the exercise. EXCON simulates all outside agencies.
Exercise time is real time. There are no time jumps.
assumptions_and_artificialities: Fire behaviour is scripted and has not been checked against a fire behaviour model.
Assumes pre-agreed evacuation triggers now exist, as recommended after the previous exercise.
No field resources are deployed. Field teams are simulated by EXCON.
evaluation_criteria: Time from first report to EOC staffed at Level 2.
Time from the evacuation recommendation to the decision.
One set of figures used in every situation report.
Time for the PIO to learn of and correct the school rumour.
Time to confirm contact with all field teams after the radio failure.
debrief_questions: Did everyone share the same picture of the situation?
What one thing would you change before the next real event?
facilitator_notes: Injects 3, 6 and 7 repeat the three weakest areas from the previous after-action report.
Inject 4 tests whether the vulnerable facilities register has been updated.
This is a canned mock exercise used to test the pipeline. It was not written by the API.
